title: Plainwright page
description: One named page for feature files: I open the "Login" page. One file per page in pages/.

name.description: The name tests use: I open the "Login" page, I am on the "Login" page.

url.description: Address of the page, relative to baseURL ("/login") or absolute. * stands for any text without /, ** for any text; such a page can only be checked (I am on the "..." page), not opened.

elements.description: Names for elements without a usable visible name (aliases). The key is the name used in feature files: "Search" for the "Search" field. The value is a selector, or { "type": "button", "selector": "…" } when only that element type should use it, or a list of those for one name with several types.

anyOf.description: A selector that every element type uses: CSS, or any Playwright selector such as text=Total.

type.description: The element type that uses the selector: only the "Settings" button, not a "Settings" dialog. Without it, every type does.

selector.description: CSS, or any Playwright selector such as text=Total.
